CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto

CREATE TABLE "customer" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER',
  CONSTRAINT "customer__role_enum" CHECK ("role" IN ('USER', 'STAFF'))
)

CREATE TABLE "product" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "version" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" bigint NOT NULL,
  "stock" bigint NOT NULL,
  "featured" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
)

CREATE TABLE "order" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "customer_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" bigint NOT NULL,
  "amount" bigint NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  "payment_ref" text,
  "paid_at" timestamptz,
  CONSTRAINT "order__status_enum" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED'))
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "customer__u3" ON "customer" ("email")

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "product__touch_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN NEW."updated_at" := now(); RETURN NEW; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "product__touch" BEFORE UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "product__touch_fn"()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "product__version_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY['stock', 'updated_at', 'version']::text[]) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY['stock', 'updated_at', 'version']::text[]) THEN NEW."version" := OLD."version" + 1; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "product__version" BEFORE UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "product__version_fn"()
ALTER TABLE "product" ADD CONSTRAINT "product__out_of_stock" CHECK (coalesce((("stock" >= 0)), false))
ALTER TABLE "order" ADD CONSTRAINT "order__customer_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("customer_id") REFERENCES "customer"("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "order__customer_id_idx" ON "order" ("customer_id")
ALTER TABLE "order" ADD CONSTRAINT "order__product_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "product"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "order__product_id_idx" ON "order" ("product_id")

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_outbox" (
  "id" bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "intent" text,
  "key" text,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "available_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "attempts" int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "last_error" text,
  "done_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_outbox_pending" ON "_aip_outbox" ("available_at") WHERE "done_at" IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_idempotency" (
  "intent" text NOT NULL,
  "actor" text NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "request_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "response" jsonb,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY ("intent", "actor", "key")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_audit" (
  "id" bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  "intent" text NOT NULL,
  "actor" uuid,
  "superuser" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  "input" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_counter_seen" (
  "key" text PRIMARY KEY,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_rate" (
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "window_start" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "count" int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("key", "window_start")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_schedule_run" (
  "name" text PRIMARY KEY,
  "last_run" timestamptz NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_processed" (
  "handler" text NOT NULL,
  "outbox_id" bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("handler", "outbox_id")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_notification" (
  "id" bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  "recipient" uuid NOT NULL,
  "template" text NOT NULL,
  "data" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "category" text,
  "read_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_notification_recipient" ON "_aip_notification" ("recipient", "created_at" DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_mail" (
  "id" bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  "template" text NOT NULL,
  "to" text,
  "data" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_grant" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "link" text NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  "scope" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "to_member" uuid,
  "issued_by" uuid,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "uses_left" int NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_verification" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "subject" uuid NOT NULL,
  "target" text NOT NULL,
  "code_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "attempts_left" int NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_approval" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "subject" uuid NOT NULL,
  "requested_by" uuid,
  "status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')),
  "required" int NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "decided_at" timestamptz
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_approval_pending" ON "_aip_approval" ("name", "subject") WHERE "status" = 'PENDING'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_approval_vote" (
  "approval" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "_aip_approval" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "voter" uuid NOT NULL,
  "decision" text NOT NULL CHECK ("decision" IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT')),
  "comment" text,
  "at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT "_aip_approval_vote_once" PRIMARY KEY ("approval", "voter")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_job" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "params" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "requested_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'QUEUED' CHECK ("status" IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'FAILED')),
  "items" jsonb,
  "total" int,
  "done" int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "file" text,
  "error" text,
  "attempts" int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "available_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "heartbeat" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "started_at" timestamptz,
  "finished_at" timestamptz
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_job_active" ON "_aip_job" ("name", "requested_by", "params") WHERE "status" IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_job_queue" ON "_aip_job" ("available_at") WHERE "status" IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_webhook_seen" (
  "webhook" text NOT NULL,
  "event_id" text NOT NULL,
  "received_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY ("webhook", "event_id")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_rule_pending" (
  "rule" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("rule", "id")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_rule_state" (
  "rule" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("rule", "id")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_sequence" (
  "scope" text PRIMARY KEY,
  "n" bigint NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_object" (
  "key" text PRIMARY KEY,
  "bucket" text NOT NULL,
  "content_type" text,
  "size" bigint NOT NULL,
  "state" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staged',
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "product__rule_soldout_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN INSERT INTO "_aip_rule_pending" VALUES ('SoldOut', NEW."id") ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; RETURN NULL; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "product__rule_soldout" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "product__rule_soldout_fn"()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "order__rule_bestseller_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN IF TG_OP <> 'DELETE' AND NEW."product_id" IS NOT NULL THEN INSERT INTO "_aip_rule_pending" VALUES ('Bestseller', NEW."product_id") ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; END IF; IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT' AND OLD."product_id" IS NOT NULL THEN INSERT INTO "_aip_rule_pending" VALUES ('Bestseller', OLD."product_id") ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; END IF; RETURN NULL; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "order__rule_bestseller" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON "order" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "order__rule_bestseller_fn"()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "product__rule_bestseller_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN INSERT INTO "_aip_rule_pending" VALUES ('Bestseller', NEW."id") ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; RETURN NULL; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "product__rule_bestseller" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "product__rule_bestseller_fn"()
